paper_metadata.title: Creep behaviour and microstructure changes of model cast Ni-Cr-W-C alloys

evidence.quote: two model cast Ni-Cr-W-C alloys (Alloys A and B) resistant to high-temperature oxidation with different contents of Cr, W, Zr and Fe
Their chemical compositions were as follows (in wt.%): Alloy A: Ni – 23.5 Cr, 14,9 Fe, 5.1 W, , 1.1 Si, 0.9 Mn, 0.3 C.
Two model alloys A and B were cast by a foundry company PBS Velká Bíteš, a.s., Czech Republic, using conical ingots with minimum diameter of 13 mm, maximum diameter of 18 mm and length of 90 mm.
Both model alloys were investigated in their as-cast states.
